en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a narrow European street with tall, closely packed buildings on both sides. At the end of the street stands a large medieval-looking building with pointed-arch windows and a tall, slender tower or spire rising into a cloudy sky. Early 20th‑century automobiles and a few pedestrians are visible in the street, suggesting an interwar period scene.
